root_cause: The hourly revenue-learning-evaluate function ran its action-evidence reconcile (up to 50 sequential RPC calls in the edge gateway) strictly before evaluation and then handled each due target with four sequential gateway round-trips, so it was aborted by the caller after about 15 seconds (HTTP 499 on every attempt at 13:00 and 13:01 UTC).
prevention: Evaluation now runs the due-evidence read concurrently with a reconcile bounded to 6 seconds (a timeout is reported as deferred, an error still fails the run), processes due targets with a worker pool of 4, and the edge gateway reconciles in parallel groups of 5 using the same RPC.

evidence.runtime_status: unverified until protected merge, edge function deployment and Netlify logs without HTTP 499 on revenue-learning-evaluate

limitations: Parallel RPC calls on distinct action ids assume the reconcile RPC is safe to run concurrently per action
A reconcile that exceeds its budget every hour would stay deferred; this is visible in the run summary as actionEvidence.deferred
